children: Electra AI reported sustained commercial momentum and strategic partnerships as its $250M+ business combination with Iron Horse advances toward a Nasdaq listing under AIBR.
Filed Form S-4 in May 2026 for the proposed business combination valued at approximately $250M+, including earn-outs.
Multiple commercial deployments: Mooving, Omega Seiki Mobility, and Propel Industries selected Electra’s EVE-Ai battery analytics.
Technical and strategic partnerships expanded platform use into BESS risk prediction, post-quantum cybersecurity, and space.
Rebranded to Electra AI in May 2026 and established a Strategic Advisory Board to support scale-up and public-market readiness.
Transaction expected to close in H2 2026, subject to stockholder approval, SEC registration, and customary closing conditions.
